title: cordula villosa
intro: Cordula villosa, commonly known as Mexican mint or false pennyroyal, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Cordula villosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help in relieving symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
